# @pogrobert/surfaces

> Generative art for every picture a site repeats: post covers, link previews, docs and changelog headers, empty states, episode art, slides and profile headers. Make a brand once, from a colour or from the site's own HTML and CSS; every cover then follows from its title, the same bytes forever. It is for pictures a site repeats; a picture of one particular thing is a photo's job. A wrong input throws an error that names the fix.

Rules for writing code with it are in AGENTS.md. In short: `const brand = createBrand({ name: "acme.dev", ...readPage(html, css) })`, then `brand.cover({ title })`, `brand.og({ title })`, `brand.hero`, `brand.card`, `brand.banner({ for: "x" })`, drawn by `toHtml`, `toSvg`, or `toJpeg`/`toPng` (from `/png`). The images are art: the site sets its titles in its own font over `scene.areas[0]`, and `drawTitle: { font: await loadFont(bytes) }` draws one in where it can't, in the site's font file (or `drawTitle: true` for a bundled face), or `<Cover brand={brand} title={title} />` (from `/react`). `generate(input)` is the lower level, for one exact cover.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules, under 1 KB
- [README.md](README.md): examples for React, OG images, DOM, SVG and HTTP
- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): the whole API and why each part is there

## Reference

- [dist/schema.json](dist/schema.json): the input as JSON Schema (also `inputSchema`)
- `catalog`: every style with what it looks like, what it suits, and its shapes
- `directions(choices)`: several varied, checked brands to show a person; keep the chosen one's `look`
- `npx @pogrobert/surfaces init`: reads the site, writes its brand, an AGENTS.md block and the link preview; `kit` writes the link preview and social headers (never icons); `preview` and `check` to look and verify
- `readPage(html, css, design?)`: the facts a brand chooses its look from: colours, background, dark mode, fonts, words; a DESIGN.md given third comes first
- `logo` on a brand: its own logo, set as it is on link previews and headers
- `validate(input)`: every problem with an input, each with its fix, without drawing
